text:
zane: Proposed pricing instrument for M1: 'Priority Credits' 10k credit packs customers prebuy to get short windows of reduced latency / higher concurrency. Goal: a simpler, opt-in burst mechanism instead of a permanent Priority Lane add-on. Thinking this reduces routing surface area but introduces billing and UI work. Quick takes? :money_with_wings:

ida: Tech POV: sounds good if credits map to a backend admission token (stateless) rather than routing table changes. We can check credit presence at the gateway and short-circuit to the fast-path. That avoids tenant-level routing rules but does need a high-throughput token check. Estimate: 2 sprints for gateway + TTL cache.

cory: Sales: customers like prepaid credits because its predictable. But well need clear examples and a pricing table. Also, watch out for enterprise deals that will ask for rollover & refund terms.

ara: RevOps: billing implication: credits are prepaid liabilities; we need a new invoice line type and reporting. Also need to decide if unused credits expire or rollover. For GA I recommend expiration (90 days) to simplify accounting.

noah: Legal: expiration is fine but must be explicit in the TOS and contract. Also callout: credits are non-refundable unless fraud/bugs. We'll need short copy for the sign-up flow and enterprise clause for negotiated rollover.

lina: UX: signup flow is straightforward: price & example usage (e.g., "10k credits ~= 10 minutes of Priority for 100 qps"). Need visible meter in Console and a CTA to activate credit sessions. Also a small toast when credits are consumed.

ida: Also a perf note: the gateway check should be cached and batched to avoid per-request DB lookups. Suggest local per-instance cache keyed by customer + credit-balance-hash with short TTL (5s).

zane: Good. Constraints: M1 ship date 2026-09-01; we must avoid big billing pipeline changes. Is there a minimum viable implementation that gets us to GA?

ara: MV: implement prepaid invoice line + simple redemption API that ops can toggle. For GA require ops support to attach credits to an account via the Console or API. No self-serve credit purchase in GA (defer to M2). That minimizes checkout/billing QA surface.

cory: That helps sales - we can create a simple order form for credit purchase handled by finance. Still need a clear pilot playbook.

noah: Legal: pilot language: "Priority Credits pilot - operator-enabled, credits expire after 90 days, non-refundable. Enterprise customers may negotiate rollover in a contract addendum." I'll draft.

lina: UI for GA then is: a hidden Console panel for Ops to attach credit packs + a customer-facing meter on the account page (read-only until M2 self-serve). Simple to build.

ida: Engineering acceptance for MV: gateway check implemented + local cache, redemption API, smoke tests that simulate credit session lifecycle, and no change to routing tables. Perf target: <1% added p99 latency for gateway. Estimate: 2 sprints.

release-bot: Release note: cut window 2026-09-01. Blocking PRs related to gateway caching: 3 open, 1 labeled critical.

zane: Decision: ship Priority Credits as operator-provisioned pilot in M1 (no self-serve), backend via gateway token check + local cache, 90-day expiry, non-refundable, enterprise rollover by contract. Plan to expand to self-serve purchase + automated topup in M2. Action items:
- ida: implement gateway token check + cache + redemption API; add smoke tests (due end of sprint)
- ara: create billing invoice line spec & pilot attach flow for Console (due Thu)
- cory: draft sales pilot playbook + pricing examples + customer-facing FAQ (due Fri)
- noah: draft legal credit clause & enterprise addendum language (due Thu)
- lina: build Console attach UI + account meter read-only mock (due Thu)
- zane: update roadmap + add milestone "Priority Credits M2 self-serve" with estimates

ida: ack 1 will open follow-up ticket `priority-credits-gateway` and link perf test plan.

ara: ack 1 will coordinate with billing on invoice line and confirm GL mapping.

cory: ack 1 will call the top-5 customers who asked about priority options and offer pilot.

noah: Posting draft into #legal for review.

lina: ack 1 starting mocks.

release-bot: Ticket created: PROD-15999 (priority-credits-pilot).

zane: Pinning this to the release checklist. If ops/infra say pilot can't be supported, escalate here immediately. Thanks team :rocket:
